mapper.insert: INSERT INTO handoff_ticket (source_type, source_id, user_id, agent_id, context, reason, status) VALUES (#{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{context}, #{reason}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.source_type AS sourceType, t.source_id AS sourceId, t.user_id AS userId, u.phone AS userPhone, t.agent_id AS agentId, t.context, t.reason, t.status, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM handoff_ticket t LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = t.user_id ORDER BY t.id DESC
